_why: Mutant ids declared BEHAVIOUR-PRESERVING for YawRateControl, each with the argument behind it. `vit_mutate.py --equivalences` reads the KEYS of this object, so the claim and its reason live in one file. A declared mutant LEAVES THE DENOMINATOR, so every entry is a claim somebody has to be able to answer. THREE are declared out of 80 mutants, and all three are at a value the program never reads: one write-only local of the reference's own, and the two placeholder arguments that stand for an OPTIONAL the reference does not pass. Every mutant on this unit's arithmetic, indexing, control flow and comparisons that the corpus can reach was KILLED -- all 9 arith_op, all 3 drop_factor, all 3 swap_operands, both index_offset, all 12 negate_cond, the drop_call and the swap_call_args, and 11 of 13 compare_op.
_not_declared: EIGHT SURVIVORS ARE ABSENT FROM THIS FILE AND WERE NOT EXCUSED, and they are one fact rather than eight. All eight sit inside this unit's two STOP arms -- `IF (NacHeadingError .le. 0)` under `YawState == 1` and `IF (NacHeadingError .ge. 0)` under `YawState == -1`, at translations/Controllers/yawratecontrol.cpp lines 277-280 and 287-290. Neither arm is entered on any of the 8093 cases, and the reason is a property of the INSTRUMENT that is measured rather than argued: entering either arm at all needs `iStatus /= 0`, because `iStatus == 0` resets `YawState` to 0 two statements earlier; and at `iStatus /= 0` the two `LPFilter` calls take their steady-state arm against a `LocalVar%FP` the harness zero-initialises on every case and does not vary, so the callee evaluates `1.0/0 * (-(0*0) + 0*x + 0*0)` = `inf * 0` = NaN and returns it. Every comparison against NaN is false, so both stop tests are false on every one of the 725 entries. evidence/YawRateControl/arm_census.txt is the measurement -- the shipped translation plus counters, run green over the same corpus: `from 1: stop 0 persist 6`, `from -1: stop 0 persist 719`. THESE ARE NOT EQUIVALENT: a defect at any of the eight is a real defect, and the layer that sees them is the KERNEL, where `FP` persists across calls as it does in the shipped program. Scenario 7 takes the right stop 12 times and the left stop 11 times in 23,999 invocations, and vit.yaml's capture window was aimed at two of them -- kernel cases 1045 and 2045 -- before any of this was known. Declaring them here would record a limitation of the differential harness as a property of the mutants.
_measurement: evidence/YawRateControl/arm_census.txt, produced by evidence/YawRateControl/yawratecontrol.arm_census_probe.cpp -- the shipped translation with counters and an atexit dump added and nothing else changed, run over all 8093 harness cases. The run is GREEN (HARNESS PASS: checked 8093 failed 0), so it is a READING of the corpus and not a perturbation of it.
49bc3976: const_tweak '1' -> '2' at `Tidx = 1`. `Tidx` IS WRITTEN HERE AND READ NOWHERE, in this procedure or in any other: `grep -rn Tidx rosco/controller/src/` returns exactly two lines in the whole of ROSCO, its `INTEGER, SAVE ::` declaration and this assignment. Its comment describes an interpolation index ("commanded yaw error is interpolated between i and i+1") for a feature the shipped source does not have. EQUIVALENT ON EVERY INPUT, not merely on this corpus: the value cannot reach any output because nothing reads it. It is transcribed at all because the reference writes it and the contract is mirror (P7); a translation that dropped the statement would be the one that needed defending.
38ca7ff2: const_tweak '0.0' -> '1.0' at the LAST argument of the first `lpfilter_c` call -- `InitialValue`, the trailing OPTIONAL. The reference passes SEVEN actual arguments (`LPFilter(cos(...), DT, F_YawErr, FP, iStatus, .FALSE., objInst%instLPF)`) and the callee's dummy list ends with `LOGICAL, OPTIONAL :: reset` ... `REAL(DbKi), OPTIONAL :: InitialValue`, so `InitialValue` is ABSENT at this call site. VIT's C signature carries an absent OPTIONAL as a present/value pair, and the present flag is passed as 0 here. `translations/Filters/lpfilter.cpp` reads it as `double InitialValue_ = InputSignal; if (has_InitialValue) InitialValue_ = InitialValue;` -- so with the flag 0 the value is never read on any path. EQUIVALENT BY CONSTRUCTION: the mutant changes the contents of a slot that stands for an argument the reference does not supply. Both sides of the harness reach that same body, because `harness.sh` step 2e drops the generated `lpfilter_c` bridge on an integrated tree and keeps `lpfilter.cpp.o`, so there is one implementation of the callee and it is the one quoted.
c3176f96: const_tweak '0.0' -> '1.0' at the last argument of the SECOND `lpfilter_c` call -- the `sin` component. Same site, same argument, same reason as 38ca7ff2 above, one line down. Declared separately because the mutator treats them as two sites, which they are.
